blurb: Guests participate in guided fishing and hunting trips targeting various species such as trout, bass, carp, ducks, and geese. Trips include half day and full day options with provided gear, meals, and beverages depending on the trip. The guide is a licensed New York State Guide with safety certifications and extensive local experience.
extraNote: $150 deposit required to secure reservation · Deposit non-refundable on packages including lodging · Deposit refundable if cancelled within 14 days for trips without lodging · Balance due on day of trip must be paid in cash or credit card · Deposit can be paid by PayPal or mailed check · Meeting locations vary by lake and trip; guests will be contacted prior to the trip to determine meeting location and time.
